Last week, Apple sued OpenAI, claiming a former employee "stole trade secrets" for OpenAI's benefit.

Reports indicate Apple has sent letters directly to several former employees who are now working at OpenAI.

According to the Financial Times, Apple has issued litigation hold notices to approximately 40 former employees.

A litigation hold notice is a formal written notice sent to an individual or organisation, requiring them to preserve documents, records, and other evidence potentially relevant to legal disputes. These letters typically clearly specify what must be preserved.

Apple suspects the theft of trade secrets may involve more individuals than those named in last week's initial lawsuit, hence this action.

As a reminder, Apple's lawsuit names OpenAI and io Products as defendants, along with former Apple employees Chang Liu and Tang Tan.

To learn more details about Apple's lawsuit against OpenAI, you can read this article:
